page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 dedicated physical core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.n2.medium sits in the lower tiers of performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated as weak (bottom 25%) with a score of 1107.09, while the multi-core performance drops to the bottom 10% with a score of 2193.58. Memory performance is similarly constrained; read-only small block bandwidth reaches 157.12 GB/sec (bottom 25%), but uncached large-block read and write bandwidths drop to 16.61 GB/sec and 14.38 GB/sec respectively, both placing in the bottom 10%. Passmark CPU and memory scores also fall into the bottom 10% category.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but lower-tier benchmark results, the ecs.n2.medium represents an entry-level general-purpose tier. It offers a predictable but modest resource profile, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without demanding high throughput or memory bandwidth. The instance is suited for lightweight applications, basic web serving (with static web serving throughput measured at 1.69 GB/sec), small-scale Redis deployments (achieving 2.49 million SET operations per second), and minor database operations.
